summary: Shared inbox help desk and knowledge base for customer support teams.
access_note: Free plan has no API access; API is on Standard, Plus and Pro. A 15-day Standard or Plus trial (no card) is the only free route. OAuth2 app created under Your Profile > My apps.
blocker_note: API requires a paid plan (a free plan exists but lacks API access); the official MCP is read-only.
notes: Authentication page is gzip-served; quotes now taken after decompression. Docs API uses a separate API key (not covered). Pricing table column mapping for 'API access' is unclear, but the vendor MCP article states API access is on Standard, Plus and Pro only.

evidence.quote: This integration is available on the Standard, Plus, and Pro plans — any plan that includes Help Scout API access.
Set the remote MCP server URL to https://mcp.helpscout.net/mcp .
When you sign up for a free trial of the Standard or Plus plan
This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization

review.reason: Free Basic plan exists but the MCP/API article says API access is on Standard, Plus and Pro; pricing FAQ: 15-day trial of Standard or Plus, no card. Trial is the only free path, as with the other helpdesk apps.
